escalations.title: Handlebars.js — Multiple JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities (8 CVEs)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides crafted Handlebars template → RCE on backend server via AST type confusion

escalations.title: Vitest — Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution via Unauthenticated UI Server
escalations.exploit_scenario: LAN attacker sends request to Vitest UI server → reads .env files, source code, executes arbitrary code
escalations.fix: npm update vitest in all 3 projects; disable --ui flag in CI

escalations.title: Protobufjs — Prototype Pollution & ReDoS in gRPC Message Deserialization
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted protobuf message → pollutes Object.prototype → arbitrary property overwrite across all process objects
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs; cd portal/Backend && npm update protobufjs

escalations.title: js-yaml — Arbitrary Code Execution via Unsafe YAML Deserialization
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides YAML with !!js/object tags to application YAML parsing → RCE if safe option not enforced
escalations.fix: Audit all js-yaml call sites; enforce {safe: true} option; npm update js-yaml

backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Has a Single-Plan Blind Spot
backlog.detail: Enforcer auto-selects one requirements.md; two full specs (FR-001..069, FR-TMP-001..010) are never validated
backlog.recommendation: Run enforcer per-plan: for f in Plans/*/requirements.md; do python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file "$f"; done

backlog.title: Enforcer Generates 7 False-Positive Failures on Dependency-Linking Plan
backlog.detail: Regex matches FR-\d+ anywhere in document; prose-embedded IDs trigger false MISSING errors
backlog.recommendation: Scope regex to table rows only: match ^\|\s*(FR-[\w-]+)\s*\|
